verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is documented as a local CLI that converts local files (`ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.avi`), with hardware-accelerated and parallel local pipelines. Hands-on users report running it on their own machines with local GPUs and batch wrappers, so on-device conversion is clearly evidenced. However, nothing in the pack shows the vendor explicitly stating that files are never uploaded, and network streams are only a user-directed I/O option. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that files are never uploaded, and a documented privacy/offline guarantee.
